items.title: Mercado Bitcoin to resume cash withdrawals after $49M hack
items.summary: Starting next week, customers can deposit and withdraw money through Brazil's instant payment system. Crypto transfers remain suspended.

items.title: Hot US inflation raises odds of half-point Fed hike in December
items.summary: US inflation came in above forecasts in October, increasing expectations of a bigger rate hike in December and raising concerns for crypto investors.

items.title: Polymarket US trading volume jumps 266% despite regulatory battles
items.summary: Trading volume on Polymarket's US exchange surged from June to October, fueled by sports betting, even as the platform faces mounting regulatory scrutiny.
